lines.en: label day20:
scene daytwenty1
It’s another average day in the classroom.
lines.zh: 教室里又是平淡无奇的一天。

lines.en: Or at least average by my standards. I'm sure the other classes are actually studying right now.
lines.zh: 或者至少按我的标准是平淡。我敢肯定其他班这会儿是真的在学习。

lines.en: But ever since I took over and decided to just let the girls study on their own time, things have more or less just...been like this.
lines.zh: 但自从我接手、并决定让女生们自己安排学习时间之后，情况就多少一直……是这个样子。

lines.en: Even Makoto seems to be settling into this new routine. So apart from Yumi, who still only shows up once in a while, it appears that everybody seems to be enjoying themselves.
lines.zh: 连 Makoto 似乎也习惯了这套新规矩。所以除了 Yumi 还是偶尔才露个面之外，看起来所有人都挺享受的。

lines.en: The great part is that it doesn't seem classes are ever monitored here. So as long as I can submit everyone's grades on time, I should be able to dodge suspicion entirely.
lines.zh: 最棒的是，这里的课似乎从来没人监督。所以只要我能按时把大家的成绩交上去，就完全可以避开怀疑。

lines.en: All that's left to do now is...figure out how to submit everyone's grades.
lines.zh: 现在唯一剩下的……就是搞清楚该怎么提交大家的成绩。

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and lean back in my chair, already excited for the day to come to an end so I can get out of here and actually do something fun with my time.
lines.zh: 我自顾自地叹了口气，往椅背上一靠，已经开始盼着这一天赶紧结束，好让我离开这儿，把时间花在真正有趣的事情上。

lines.en: It is at that moment when I realize that all I have to do in order to make that happen is go to sleep.
lines.zh: 就在那一刻，我意识到，要让这一切成真，我唯一要做的事就是睡觉。

lines.en: And so that is precisely what I will do.
lines.zh: 所以，我正打算这么做。

lines.en: Goodnight, everyone.
lines.zh: 晚安，各位。

lines.en: Please don't cause any trouble while I am gone. And, in the event that I wake up without my memories, please ask Ami to once again escort me home.
lines.zh: 我不在的时候，请别惹麻烦。还有，万一我醒来时又失忆了，请让 Ami 再送我回家一次。

lines.en: Several minutes later...
lines.zh: 几分钟后……

lines.en: scene daytwenty2
scene daytwenty3
: Hey!
: Ahh! Hand!
lines.zh: : 啊！手！

lines.en: : Something going on outside? You’ve been staring at the window for like ten minutes now.
lines.zh: : 外面有什么情况吗？你都盯着窗户看了快十分钟了。

lines.en: : Uhhhh...air! That's where all the air is! And the...uhh...birds!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……空气！空气都在外面！还有……呃……鸟！

lines.en: : Anyway, good talk! Thank you!
lines.zh: : 总之，聊得很愉快！谢谢！

lines.en: scene daytwenty4
: Did I scare you or something? I wasn't trying to sneak up on you like that.
lines.zh: : 我吓到你了吗？我不是有意那样悄悄凑过来的。

lines.en: : Huh? What? No? Scared? I've never been scared of anything in my life. Not even once.
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？没有啊？害怕？我这辈子从来没怕过任何东西。一次都没有。

lines.en: : Do, umm...do you need something?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……你找我有事吗？

lines.en: scene daytwenty5
: Nah...
: Just thought I'd come say hi since you seemed all lonely and stuff.
lines.zh: : 只是看你好像挺孤单什么的，就想过来打个招呼。

lines.en: : I can leave if I'm bothering you, though. I put up with Yumi on a daily basis, so I know pretty well how much some people need their alone time or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不过我要是打扰到你了，我可以走。我天天跟 Yumi 混在一起，所以很清楚有些人有多需要独处的时间什么的。

lines.en: : I am never washing this cardigan again.
lines.zh: : 这件开衫我再也不洗了。

lines.en: scene daytwenty5r
: Hm? You say something just now?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你刚说了什么吗？

lines.en: : Nope! Nothing at all! Just...thinking about...things. And stuff.
lines.zh: : 没有！什么都没说！只是在……想……一些事情。还有东西。

lines.en: scene daytwenty6
: Well, speaking of things and stuff, I was actually thinking about you this morning.
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然说到事情和东西，我今天早上其实想到了你。

lines.en: : You...of me?....Thinking? With brain?
lines.zh: : 你……想到了我？……用脑子？在想？

lines.en: : Chika think of Rin with brain, yes.
lines.zh: : Chika 用脑子想 Rin，是的。

lines.en: : Why brain think?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 脑子为什么要想？！为什么？！

lines.en: : Surely your...free time is better spent on...being pretty. And...smelling nice.
lines.zh: : 你的……空闲时间肯定更适合用来……变漂亮吧。还有……闻起来香香的。

lines.en: scene daytwenty6r
: Oh, stop! We've known each other for how many years now? I'm allowed to think of you if I want to, dummy.
lines.zh: : 哦，别说了！我们都认识多少年了？我想想你也不行吗，笨蛋。

lines.en: : Relax, Rin. You fell asleep in class and this is all just a dream. But still, try not to say anything awkward.
lines.zh: : 冷静点，Rin。你是在课堂上睡着了，这一切都只是个梦。不过还是尽量别说些尴尬的话。

lines.en: : Oh my god. You are like, totally hilarious.
lines.zh: : 我的天。你这个人真是太搞笑了。

lines.en: scene daytwenty6r2
: So...umm...why were you thinking of me, exactly? If that's...a thing I'm allowed to ask about.
lines.zh: : 那么……呃……你到底为什么想到我？如果……这是我被允许问的话。

lines.en: : I just heard this band on my Discover Weekly this morning and they seemed like something you'd be into.
lines.zh: : 我今天早上的 Discover Weekly 里听到一个乐队，感觉你会喜欢。

lines.en: : I think I remember you having one of their shirts back in middle school and everything.
lines.zh: : 我记得你中学的时候还穿过他们的 T 恤什么的。

lines.en: : You don't think it's weird, do you? That I remember that and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你不觉得奇怪吧？我还记得那种事什么的。

lines.en: : No...No, that's not weird at all! I'm actually really flattered!
lines.zh: : 不……不，这一点都不奇怪！我真的受宠若惊！

lines.en: : I...remember stuff about you from back then as well, so...
lines.zh: : 我……也记得你那时候的一些事，所以……

lines.en: : Do you? Like what?
lines.zh: : 是吗？比如什么？

lines.en: : Like...umm...that one week where you came to school with green hair because your hair didn't bleach correctly...
lines.zh: : 比如……呃……有那么一个星期，你因为头发没漂好，顶着一头绿发来上学……

lines.en: scene daytwenty6r3
: That's what you remember most about me?! Why does your biggest middle school memory of me have to be one of the most embarrassing weeks of my life?!
lines.zh: : 你对我印象最深的就是这个？！为什么你中学时代对我最深的记忆，偏偏得是我这辈子最丢人的那几个星期之一啊？！

lines.en: : I didn't think it was bad or anything! I actually thought you...kind of pulled it off.
lines.zh: : 我又不觉得那有什么不好！我其实觉得你……还挺驾驭得住的。

lines.en: : But...you also pull off, like...literally everything, so...
lines.zh: : 不过……你基本上……什么都能驾驭，所以……

lines.en: scene daytwenty7
: God...that feels like, so long ago now. It's crazy to think it's only been a couple of years.
lines.zh: : 天哪……那感觉已经是好久以前的事了。想想明明才过去几年，真是不可思议。

lines.en: : How come we never hung out?
lines.zh: : 为什么我们从来没一起出去玩过？

lines.en: : Because...you're popular and awesome and everyone likes you. And I'm just Rin.
lines.zh: : 因为……你受欢迎又厉害，人人都喜欢你。而我只是 Rin。

lines.en: scene daytwenty9
: Well, I think Rin is pretty great. And I'm not that popular. The only reason I have so many followers is because I keep up with trends and stuff. It's really no big deal.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我倒觉得 Rin 挺好的。而且我也没那么受欢迎。我有那么多粉丝，只是因为我一直在追潮流什么的。真没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Speaking of that, though, how do you like having the corner desk? It's probably really easy to hide your phone, right?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你喜欢坐角落那个位子吗？藏手机应该很容易吧？

lines.en: : It is, yeah...
lines.zh: : 是挺容易的，嗯……

lines.en: : Not like we really have to hide it anymore, though, with Sensei still in the throes of his midlife crisis.
lines.zh: : 不过现在也不用真的藏了，Sensei 还陷在他的中年危机里呢。

lines.en: : You really think that's what it is? Maybe he's just been kinda cool this whole time and we've just...never realized it.
lines.zh: : 你真觉得是这么回事？也许他一直都还挺酷的，只是我们……从来没发现而已。

lines.en: : Well...whatever it is, it's definitely an improvement.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管是什么，确实是个进步。

lines.en: scene daytwenty10
if rin_love > 4 and rinfirstvisit == False:
: He’s like...a totally different person lately.
lines.zh: : 他最近……简直像变了一个人。

lines.en: : He's even been coming to the cafe lately and letting me try out new drinks on him.
lines.zh: : 他最近甚至还会来咖啡馆，让我拿他试新饮品。

lines.en: : It just...came out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 这事儿……完全来得莫名其妙。

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: jump restofrin
if rin_love > 4 and rinfirstvisit == True:
: He’s like...a totally different person lately.
lines.zh: : 他最近……简直像变了一个人。

lines.en: : This might sound kinda weird, but he even came into my room the other day. I wasn't expecting that at all.
lines.zh: : 这话可能听起来有点怪，不过他前几天甚至还进了我的房间。我完全没想到。

lines.en: scene daytwenty10r
: What? You let him into your room? But, like...what if he tried to...you know.
lines.zh: : 什么？你让他进你房间了？可是，那个……万一他打算……你知道的。

lines.en: scene daytwenty5r
: Sensei? No way. It wasn't like that at all.
lines.zh: : Sensei？不可能。根本不是那么回事。

lines.en: : You sure? What if he's got a crush on you or something?
lines.zh: : 你确定？万一他暗恋你什么的呢？

lines.en: : Not a chance. He's...way older than us. He was probably just...really bored or something.
lines.zh: : 绝无可能。他……比我们大太多了。他大概只是……太无聊了什么的。

lines.en: : Older guys are into teenagers all the time, Rin. I don't think it's impossible, you know?
lines.zh: : 成熟男人喜欢女高中生这种事，一直都有啊，Rin。我可不觉得不可能，你知道吗？

lines.en: : I told you, it's not like that. Besides, I'm like, last on the list of people who would be his type. I think.
lines.zh: : 我说了，不是那么回事。再说了，我大概……是他喜欢的类型里排最末的那个吧。我想。

lines.en: : I actually don't really know. But there's no way he has a crush on me.
lines.zh: : 其实我也说不准。不过他绝对不可能暗恋我。

lines.en: scene daytwenty10
: Whatever you say...
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说……

lines.en: : I do get what you mean by the whole different person lately thing, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你说的「最近像变了一个人」，我倒是懂。

lines.en: jump restofrin
else:
: He’s like...a totally different person lately.
lines.zh: : 他最近……简直像变了一个人。

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: jump restofrin
label restofrin:
: It's like...not just him either. It feels like the entire class has been different for the last couple weeks.
lines.zh: : 而且……也不只是他。感觉最近这几个星期，整个班都不一样了。

lines.en: : It barely even feels like school anymore.
lines.zh: : 这儿几乎都不像学校了。

lines.en: scene daytwenty10r2
: What, do you like...miss learning all of a sudden or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你该不会……突然想念学习了什么的吧？

lines.en: : I always thought you hated studying.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为你最讨厌学习了。

lines.en: : I don't hate it! It's just boring.
lines.zh: : 我才不讨厌！只是很无聊而已。

lines.en: scene daytwenty10
: I wonder if something happened to him. People don't just change like that overnight, do they?
lines.zh: : 我在想他是不是出了什么事。人总不会一夜之间就变成那样吧？

lines.en: : I’m sure he’s fine. If anything was going on with him, I'm sure I'd hear about it from Ami anyway.
lines.zh: : 我肯定他没事。真要有什么事，我也一定会从 Ami 那儿听说的。

lines.en: scene daytwenty11
: Well, let me know if you do hear anything, since I'm just as curious about all this as you are.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你要是真听到什么就告诉我，我跟你一样好奇。

lines.en: : Also, hang out with me some time. If you're free, I mean.
lines.zh: : 还有，什么时候跟我一起出去玩吧。我是说，如果你有空的话。

lines.en: scene daytwenty11r
: H...Hang out?! You and me?! Together?! In the same place?!
lines.zh: : 出……出去玩？！你和我？！一起？！在同一个地方？！

lines.en: : Yeah! It’ll be fun. Just come get me after class sometime. We’ll go shopping or get dinner or something.
lines.zh: : 对啊！会很好玩的。哪天下课后来找我就行。我们去逛街或者吃饭什么的。

lines.en: : Is that...cool with you? Or should we just stay as like, school friends or something?
lines.zh: : 这样……你可以吗？还是说我们就只做……学校里的朋友什么的？

lines.en: : I'm sorry, I just...I wasn't expecting you to actually want to be around me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是……没想到你真的会想待在我身边。

lines.en: : Well, I'll let you sleep on it. But, like I said, just come get me after school if you ever want to do something.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那你就慢慢想吧。不过就像我说的，想做点什么的时候，放学后来找我就行。

lines.en: : As long as I don't have anything else going on, I'd be happy to chill with you.
lines.zh: : 只要我这边没别的事，我很乐意跟你一起混。

lines.en: : I should probs be heading back to my seat now, though. Need to do at least some studying if I want to pass, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该回座位了。想及格的话，总得多少学一点吧，你知道的？

lines.en: : But I'll see you around, Rin. It was nice chatting with you.
lines.zh: : 那回头见，Rin。跟你聊天很开心。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah it was...really nice...
lines.zh: : 嗯，真的很开心……

lines.en: scene daytwenty12
: Futaba...was I hallucinating just now? Or did that really just happen?
lines.zh: : Futaba……我刚才是出现幻觉了吗？还是说真的发生了？

lines.en: : Heheh...it really happened, Rin.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是真的发生了，Rin。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : How do you feel?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Dizzy. Very dizzy.
lines.zh: : 头晕。非常晕。

lines.en: : I am going to sleep now. But if I start making weird noises or talking or something, please hit me.
lines.zh: : 我要睡了。不过要是我开始发出奇怪的声音或者说梦话什么的，请打我一下。

lines.en: : I will hit you with the biggest book I have...
lines.zh: : 我会用我最厚的那本书打你……

lines.en: scene black
$ day20 = True
